root_cause.text: In the `stm32_ospi_remove()` function, returning early on `pm_runtime_resume_and_get()` failure skipped cleanup of the SPI controller and other resources, causing a resource leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes the early return (`if (ret < 0) return;`) after `pm_runtime_resume_and_get()`, ensuring cleanup runs regardless of PM resume result. The commit message and CVE description confirm that the early return prevented proper cleanup.
